days.title: Commit one duplicate-safe synthetic receipt
days.prerequisite_note: Entrance gate: demonstrated Day 35 atomic source issuance/event/idempotency, transaction/rollback/resource cleanup and local runtime. Scaffold, date, or temporary witness do not satisfy learner completion.

engineering.scope: The receipt is the full synthetic effect. Identical replay is a no-op; same-key changed payload fails; original fields/time never change. Before receipt: work key K has payload P. First request with same K but payload Q is rejected and creates no receipt. P creates one receipt; replay P preserves its original received_at; later Q still conflicts and never overwrites the receipt.

engineering.scope: Capture and drain at most one validated batch per invocation. Commit receipt before acknowledgment for each selected item; stop at first error, report committed progress, no auto retry or skip. Worked row-state trace: capture batch K1/K2 once → receipt K1 commits → ack K1 commits → receipt K2 fails → stop; K1 remains delivered and K2 remains pending. Do not loop into the next page or silently swallow the error.
